import hashlib
import json
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

source = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-referral/2026-11-19-direct-catalogue-readback.html')
checker = Path('products/services/merchant-v1-group-id-sample/runnable-controls/check.py')

class MailLinks(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.templates = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag != 'a':
            return
        target = urlsplit(dict(attrs).get('href', ''))
        if target.scheme != 'mailto':
            return
        body = parse_qs(target.query).get('body', [''])[0]
        if body:
            self.templates.append(body)

source_bytes = source.read_bytes()
links = MailLinks()
links.feed(source_bytes.decode('utf-8'))
required = ['expected_family', 'offer_id', 'item_group_id']
checker_bytes = checker.read_bytes()
assert all(json.dumps(field).encode() in checker_bytes for field in required)
report = {
    'scope': 'Exact field-name check of prefilled mail-link bodies in the saved 19 November public capture. Visible instructions and equivalent French or English wording require separate review. No email client, private correspondence or buyer activity was tested.',
    'source': str(source),
    'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest(),
    'checker_sha256': hashlib.sha256(checker_bytes).hexdigest(),
    'required_checker_headers': required,
    'templates': [
        {'ordinal': index, 'exact_field_names_present': [field for field in required if field in body.casefold()], 'exact_field_names_absent': [field for field in required if field not in body.casefold()]}
        for index, body in enumerate(links.templates, 1)
    ],
    'template_count': len(links.templates),
}
output = Path('products/services/catalogue-inquiry-completeness/director-template-field-evidence.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
